meta.name: memory-retrieve
meta.description: Load only the minimum relevant memory for a task using 3-level progressive disclosure. Activate before context-building — never load full memory dumps. Never substitute summaries for durable memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按任务检索最小相关记忆，避免加载完整记忆转储
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在构建上下文前高效加载相关记忆，避免信息冗余
copy.tagline_en: Retrieve only relevant memory for tasks, avoiding full memory dumps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to load relevant memory efficiently before context building without full dumps

howto.what: Claude只加载与当前任务相关的最少记忆。先读索引文件，再按需加载具体决策文件，必要时扫描跨域冲突。不加载全部记忆，也不用摘要代替完整决策。
howto.when: 当任务需要历史上下文时，在构建上下文之前触发。从不加载完整记忆，始终按相关性筛选。

say.text: 帮我查一下计费模块的决策记录。
say.note: Claude会读取索引，加载相关的决策文件。

say.text: 实现这个新功能前，回顾之前的架构决策。
say.note: 触发记忆检索，只加载相关决策。

say.text: 看看匹配算法的决策有没有冲突。

howto.what_en: Claude loads only the minimum relevant memory for a task via 3-level progressive disclosure: first scan index, then load specific decision files, optionally cross-domain scan. Never loads full memory or substitutes summaries for durable memory.
howto.when_en: Triggered before context-building when a task requires historical context. Never loads full memory; always filters by relevance.

say_en.text: Retrieve decisions for the billing module.
say_en.note: Claude reads index and loads relevant decision files.

say_en.text: Before implementing this feature, review past architectural decisions.
say_en.note: Triggers memory retrieval for relevant decisions.

say_en.text: Check for conflicts among matching algorithm decisions.
